tables.name: Arcane District Hired Help
tables.description: The Arcane district's included hired help: 1-3 Arcane Academics, 4-6 Magic Mercenaries.

results.name: Hired Help - Arcane Academics
results.description: Experts in matters of magic and lore (may also be natural magic or something else; it need not be exclusively arcane).

results.name: Hired Help - Magic Mercenaries
results.description: Specialists trained the use of arcane or non-divine magic in combat and practical mission scenarios.
